# Four domains chosen to be as far apart as possible: cell biology, computer security, retail marketing, and river hydrology

Four domains chosen to be as far apart as possible: cell biology, computer security, retail marketing, and river hydrology. This room exists to test whether the connection engines can find a genuine cross-domain match between artifacts that describe the same underlying mechanism in unrelated vocabularies, and can avoid being fooled by two artifacts that merely share a word.
